title.narrative: Water supply and environmental sanitation in Hajjah Governorate

description.narrative: Preserving the lives of displaced people and citizens by continuing to provide safe and healthy sources of water in areas where displaced people gather in Hajjah Governorate (Hiran / Midi / Abs) / disposing of waste and rubbish in a safe and healthy way / preventive maintenance of water tanks, sewage, and toilets / raising awareness for citizens and displaced people

Saving lives, preserving their continuity, reducing the spread of diseases and epidemics, and ensuring a safe, healthy and secure environment for displaced people and citizens by providing basic services in the water and environmental sanitation sector through maintaining wells and pumps and establishing a drinking water desalination plant.

The ability of a number of water wells to pump and preserve water and provide sustainable water solutions / Pumping and distributing potable and similar water for domestic use / Reducing the spread of diseases and epidemics for displaced people and citizens / Preserving human dignity by securing their water needs and preserving their lives / Providing and preserving water tanks and those around them The safety of septic tanks, preventing leaks, providing toilets, maintaining a safe and sound environment, and sustaining the project’s activities through their periodic maintenance / providing designated places for placing, collecting, and disposing of waste in a safe, environmentally healthy way, while limiting the spread of rodents and disease vectors, and spreading the degree of awareness among the displaced in a clean, healthy environment for a number of people. (51,128) beneficiaries
